description: Implementation of QuicReceivedPacketManager class handling packet reception, acknowledgment logic, and related state management in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages received packets, acknowledgment frames, and related state for QUIC protocol.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures acknowledgment behavior based on provided QUIC configuration.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records receipt of a packet, updates acknowledgment state, and handles ECN counters.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Generates an acknowledgment frame with current packet receipt info.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Stops waiting for packets before a specified packet number.

methods.name: GetMaxAckDelay
methods.description: Calculates maximum delay before sending an acknowledgment based on RTT and configuration.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckFrequency
methods.description: Adjusts acknowledgment frequency based on received packets.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Updates acknowledgment timeout based on packet receipt and missing packets.

methods.name: HasMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are missing packets that need acknowledgment.

methods.name: HasNewMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are new missing packets since last acknowledgment.

methods.name: ack_frame_updated
methods.description: Indicates if the acknowledgment frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest packet number observed.

methods.name: PeerFirstSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the first packet number sent by the peer.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame contains no packets.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles reception of an acknowledgment frequency frame.
